### **5.5 Additional Transaction Mechanisms**

In Sections 5.3 and 5.4 you learned about the two primary mechanisms used to support transactions: two-phase locking and logging. In this section, you will extend your knowledge into two more advanced areas: how isolation can be reduced in order to increase concurrency (Section 5.5.1) and how multiple transaction participants can be coordinated using the two-phase commit protocol (Section 5.5.2).

query.intent: Find how to use a zero-initialized semaphore to order completion and continuation in two threads.
query.text: How can a semaphore initialized to zero coordinate completion between two threads?
